mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order`(goods_id, goods_title, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, fee, status, created_at) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{goodsTitle}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{amount}, #{fee}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u1.nickname AS buyer_name, u2.nickname AS seller_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u1 ON o.buyer_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON o.seller_id = u2.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT o.*, u1.nickname AS buyer_name, u2.nickname AS seller_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u1 ON o.buyer_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON o.seller_id = u2.id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT o.*, u1.nickname AS buyer_name, u2.nickname AS seller_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u1 ON o.buyer_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON o.seller_id = u2.id WHERE o.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.*, u1.nickname AS buyer_name, u2.nickname AS seller_name, g.cover AS goods_cover FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u1 ON o.buyer_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON o.seller_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.id WHERE o.status = #{status} ORDER BY o.id DESC
